def fmt(s, old=False):
 s=round(s)
 m=(s+30)//60 if old else s//60
 h=(m+30)//60 if old else m//60
 m-=h*60
 hs='s' if h>1 else ''
 ms='s' if m>1 else ''
 if h:
  return f'{h} hour{hs}, {m} minute{ms}' if old or m else f'{h} hour{hs}'
 return f'{m} minute{ms}' if m else '< 1 minute'
for s in [30,59.4,59.5,60,1770,1800,3599,3600,3660,5400,7200]:
 print(s, repr(fmt(s,True)), '->', repr(fmt(s)))
for s in range(86401):
 m=s//60; h=m//60; m-=h*60
 assert 0<=m<60 and h*3600+m*60<=s<h*3600+m*60+60
print('Checked nonnegative minute remainder and whole-minute decomposition for integer seconds 0..86400.')
